**Points of no return.** The pivot of the step is the local decision-record write of `WriteOffDecisionRecordWriter`, which commits with the rows before any change (DP-03). The pivot activity waits on the central ledger acknowledgement (strict mode) on the workflow's own retry schedule (X5); the timeout is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2018).
